sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated antibody labeling of the extracellular HA epitope on intact cells (L4). Electrophysiological function of the HA-tagged construct not explicitly reported in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states the HA tag was inserted 'after glycine 221' in the first extracellular domain of full-length Kv2.1 (KCNB1), and L2 corroborates this with a named restriction-site insertion at Gly221. Python verification confirms residue 221 is G and residue 222 is Q, both within ECL1 (210–231). The position is 12 aa from TM1 and 11 aa from TM2, providing ample room for a 15–23 aa ALFA-tag insert. Surface display of the epitope was directly demonstrated by live-cell antibody labeling. L1 reports a single HA epitope (YPYDVPDYA) inserted into the first extracellular domain of full-length Kv2.1 (KCNB1) after Gly221, expressed for surface labeling studies. L2 independently confirms a restriction-site-mediated insertion engineered at Gly221 in the same full-length Kv2.1 construct. Python confirms seq[220]='G' and seq[221]='Q'; position 221 lies within ECL1 (topology span 210–231), 12 aa from the TM1 C-boundary (209) and 11 aa from the TM2 N-boundary (232), well clear of both TM edges. L4 confirms antibody detection of the extracellular epitope on surface-expressed channels.

sources.claim: To generate HA-Kv2.1 and HA-Kv9.1, a single copy of the hemagglutinin (HA) epitope sequence YPYDVPDYA was inserted within the first extracellular domain after glycine 221 and 260, respectively [ 22 ].

literature_notes: L3 and L4 provide loop-level support for an insertion in ECL1 (between TM1 and TM2) but name no residue; they are subsumed by L1/L2 which pin the exact junction at G221. L5 (KCNB1-HA resource table entry) and L6 (HA-tagged Kv2.1 in HEK293T) name no residue position and cannot independently pin a site; they are consistent with the G221 site but add no new junction. L7, L8, and L9 report mScarlet fused to the N-terminus of Kv2.1; the N-terminus (residues 1–189) is intracellular per the authoritative topology, so these are intracellular tags recorded in other_positions. ECL2 (280–294) and ECL3 (352–391) are not supported by any ledger line reporting a tolerated insertion and are therefore not proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: mScarlet fused to the N-terminus of Kv2.1; the N-terminus (residues 1–189) is intracellular per topology, so this is an intracellular fluorescent-protein fusion, not a surface tag.
